The Pumpkin between her cupped hands, transitioning from deep orange near the stem to translucent pink and brilliant white near the bottom. An intense yellow-white radiance shines from within the pumpkin, illuminating her fingers, chin, bare shoulders, and bent knees.
Thin black vines and thorn-covered branches twist around her body and across the foreground. Wisps of dark, ragged fabric blend into the tangled vegetation surrounding her crouched figure.
The composition is intimate and nearly symmetrical, with her glowing wings filling the upper background and the radiant pumpkin forming the central focal point. Cool emerald shadows contrast sharply with saturated brown illumination, while the surrounding forest dissolves into near-blackness.
